failure.causeObserved: Nested fraction sizing renders numerator/denominator leaves below the required figure text size.

metricDistinction.computedFont: Actual computed CSS size of visible leaf text; 12.8128px for E fraction leaves, not the 18.304px parent.
metricDistinction.isolatedFontInk: Canvas measureText actualBoundingBoxAscent + Descent in the browser font: 8.53146 to 8.81328px for the small fraction leaves.
metricDistinction.domVisualBounds: DOM Range layout rectangles of those leaves are 15px high. They are not glyph ink height and do not satisfy a 16px font threshold.
metricDistinction.pageRaster: Two actual viewport screenshots were visually inspected; no screenshot-pixel segmentation or OCR was performed.
metricDistinction.svg: Radical SVG element boxes can include intentional long tails; evidence retains the effective hide-tail/ stretchy clipping box instead of treating full SVG element width as painted ink.

completed.controls: 116 labels A-E independently on/off, direct native cumulative selection, native deselection, Space on/off, 117 label on and direct native off, reciprocal group isolation.
completed.prompt: All-valid selection prompt present and contained at both widths.
completed.E: Three headers and eight rows of three nonempty cells; leftmost and rightmost endpoints for every row; row eight fully within the table; loaded fonts and leaf layout boxes contained in their cells.
completed.layout: Added E height remains in normal flow, 117 starts after 116, end-navigation box is below 117, no document horizontal overflow.

observations.desktop: Full E table, all eight rows and all three columns visible. Native E checkbox visibly on. E formula ink has no observed collision/clipping, but fraction digits are small. 117 is visually separate below E; its unchanged mathematical content is not assessed.
observations.mobile: At the recorded right endpoint, E header plus all eight rows and every third-column cell are visible without observed overlap/clipping. Column one is intentionally offscreen to the left; its reach was measured at scrollLeft 0. Native E checkbox visibly off. 117 starts visibly below E.
